motion_rule: hero crosses frame each beat, never rooted; camera always moving, shot size changes every beat; crowd and crates rip past; something fills the lens each beat; one action per beat; motion across frame or at the lens
character: a spotted hyena, shaggy, no clothes, upright on hind legs, head over a third of the frame, the same hyena throughout, jaw opens on each syllable
second_characters: A SWARM of tiny animal merchants, always a shoulder from the lens, cutting across frame with bowls held up; ONE merchant in striped socks returns three times
props: his own canvas pay sack, heaped with coins from beat 1; A SWARM of blank unmarked coins; clean round cartoon holes through both his paws, like a colander, dry and bloodless; merchants' bowls and trays
prop_continuity: one sack only, always in his paws and bare by 8.50; the holes are in his paws the whole clip and only become visible at 3.05; coins keep falling through them to the end
environment: packed noon market, crates, awnings, cloth an arm away

light_events.event: hard noon sun, sunlit walls, hard racing shadows, sun shines through the holes in his paws

audio.delivery: male, low, dry, flat, sets each word down whole, 3.6 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: po-lu-CHIL, zar-PLA-tu, na RU-ki, RU-ki, o-ka-ZA-lis, dy-RYA-vy-ye; latin hints are never spoken
audio.pacing: first word on frame one, last word ends by 7.75, after it coin rattle and market din fill the track
audio.lip_sync: accurate, jaw opens on every syllable

timeline.action: muzzle fills the lens, the heaped sack in his paw, striding across frame; A SWARM rides the sack and waves bowls at the lens
still striding, he tips the sack and pours the coins into his open paw at the lens
the coins drain straight through his paw in three streams onto the stones; A SWARM dives under them with bowls
on the move he swaps the load to the other paw and that stream pours through too, coins fanning across frame; ONE merchant in striped socks skids under it
he thrusts both open paws into the lens, noon sun shining through the round holes, the last coins running out of them; A SWARM fills its bowls below
walking at the lens he snaps the bare sack across frame; ONE merchant in striped socks hurls a full bowl past his ear
striding, he plunges his paw into a merchant's coin tray and the whole tray drains through him onto the stones
muzzle fills frame, he claps one paw over his eye and stares at the camera through the hole in it, still walking; A SWARM rips across behind his back

must_appear: the heaped sack at 0.00; coins pouring through his paw from 3.05; both open paws at the lens 5.20-7.75; merchants with bowls in every beat; his eye through the hole at 9.25; every line spoken by 7.75
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, gloom, night, dark scene, digits, an inscription, garbled words, Latin letters, a static camera, a still background, an empty market, standing in place, an establishing shot, walking away from the lens, slow motion, a closed jaw while speaking, English speech, extra limbs, a second hyena in frame, merchants grabbing or carrying the hyena, the hyena biting or chewing anything, blood or wounds on his paws, a repeated or stuttered word
